notes: 1.11.2 Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Maharasthra, Madhya Pradesh and Punjab together
recorded around 77 per cent of the crimes reported under the Act’. Uttar Pradesh
also recorded 63.6 per cent of the cases reported under the "Arms Act’. Tamil Nadu, Gujarat
and Maharashtra together cover almost all the cases (99.9%) registered under the “Prohibition
Act’, in the country. The state of Jammu & Kashmir alone recorded 77.3 per cent of the total
cases registered in the country under the *TADA Act’.
